Zhao2 (city mayor) directed procurement of white wine from the company for government reception, value 120+ million RMB. Then Zhao1 gave Zhao2 300,000 RMB as bribe to thank and to continue being designated supplier. Zhao2 accepted. So this is bribery: a public official (Zhao2) receiving bribe, and a private person (Zhao1) giving bribe. The crime is "行贿" (bribery) for the private person, and "受贿" for the public official. However the indictment is against the company and Zhao1.
